penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Resolving Named Query MCP parameter-type failures in a specific Salesforce org requires per-customer investigation of their implementation, org setup, and Salesforce platform version — bespoke manual work each time.

rationale: The MCP-Named Query parameter bug is a narrower, more specific pain than the Agentforce-Flow issue and affects a smaller slice of the already-small population of developers building MCP agents on Salesforce. Even if productized as a test harness or integration library, delivery and debugging would require per-customer manual involvement. After penalties, total is 3.0 and operational_autonomy fails its gate. The market is too narrow and the delivery model too manual for the factory.
solution_plan: Not viable as an autonomous factory micro-service. The audience is a very small subset of Salesforce developers working on a cutting-edge and still-buggy Salesforce feature; at this stage it's closer to a niche Stack Overflow contribution than a sellable product. A test harness could theoretically be built, but selling, onboarding, and supporting enterprise Salesforce customers requires hands-on consulting engagement. Drop.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy (4 < 7) build gate. Total after penalty is 3.0, below validate threshold.
